bounded_question: Can one restrained structural grammar distinguish default, keyboard focus, selected, focus+selected and disabled states across neutral APP-like and WEB-like carriers without depending on candidate color, motion, iconography, imagery, material, bespoke typography, semantic status meaning, product-specific vocabulary, or CLR-01?

F1.name: Conventional Ring + Fill
F1.binding_falsifier: mechanism is too generic to add useful identity beyond platform convention
F1.rationale: The selected state is a conventional fill plus heavier boundary. It is mechanically clear but contributes no meaningful Kymaean-specific structural character beyond a generic calibration control.

F2.name: Ring + Edge Witness
F2.rationale: Focus remains an independent outer ring while selection is a restrained persistent edge witness. APP uses an inline-start witness and WEB a low horizontal witness, but both read as one underlying edge-witness mechanism. The carrier remains subordinate to neutral content, survives 320 reflow, avoids edit/crop shorthand, and introduces no product semantics.

F3.name: Ring + Opposing Brackets
F3.binding_falsifier: selected state primarily reads as editing/cropping/resize tooling
F3.rationale: Opposing corner brackets strongly resemble crop/selection handles. The mechanism is authored and mechanically distinct, but its dominant conventional association is editing/tooling rather than neutral selection state.

F4.name: Weight + Depth
F4.binding_falsifier: state carrier becomes more visually authoritative than neutral content
F4.secondary_falsifier: mechanism implies product semantics absent from the fixture
F4.rationale: Bold weight, one-pixel lift and depth shadow make the state feel physically pressed/elevated and substantially more assertive than the neutral carrier. The dotted focus ring further changes the focus voice rather than keeping state treatment quietly subordinate.

integration_sensitivities: The edge witness must remain a secondary selection carrier once CLR-01 is reintroduced; color may reinforce it but must not replace it.
APP/WEB orientation adaptation must preserve one edge-witness grammar rather than become two unrelated decorative rules.
Later component geometry must not make the witness resemble a progress bar, navigation indicator, validation stripe or semantic status marker.
Real product semantics and focus management remain implementation/engineering truths independent of this visual packet.

authority_limit: F2 is a provisional bounded state-treatment mechanism for later packet composition only. No production control tokens, semantic-state system, app/site implementation, final identity or Phase-C convergence is authorized.
